## Orientation

Territory: skills/kinds-and-focus.md, skills/engage/SKILL.md, skills/discuss/SKILL.md, skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md, skills/verify-work/SKILL.md, skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md, and skill tests under tests/test_discuss_skill.py (and any focused skill doc test). Do not edit dashboard/ or scripts/dashboard*.py — concurrent task dashboard-dismiss owns those.

Worktree (code writes only): /home/andrewyin/se-workflow--needs-you-close
Do not edit .artifacts/. Do not call adaptive-artifacts. Return the evidence block only.

Verify with: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py tests/test_discuss_skill.py -q (and any -k engage / clear filters your new tests need).

### Requirements (R1, R2, R3)

R1: When the user answers a continuity-question, decides a needs:human finding, or signs a manual check in an agent session, the parent session clears that Needs-you source at the event (question → answered; finding superseded with needs none; check-run corrected with signed_by set).

R2: engage lists open human-dismissible Needs-you items for the focus (open questions, needs:human findings, unsigned manual checks) and reminds the agent to clear them when settled; it does not refuse to route solely because those items are open.

R3: Skills that open those human gates (discuss, plan-phase, verify-work, execute-phase as applicable) document the matching clear command so closing is not left to ad-hoc memory.

### Design Invariants

No dashboard-local dismiss cache. Human-dismissible set is questions + needs-human + unsigned-check only. Skill and dashboard clears are CLI-equivalent outcomes.

### Design Assumptions

adaptive-artifacts available to the dashboard process. Signer identity for manual checks is available (config, env, or short prompt).

### Decisions

- engage-remind: remind on engage; do not block routing
- dismiss-human-gates: dismiss questions, needs:human findings, and unsigned manual checks only
